description_en: Modifies a device registration policy for your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号下设备注册策略
name: UpdateRegistrationPolicy

parameters.help_en: The name of the device registration policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 这是一条设备注册策略
parameters.help_en: The description of the device registration policy. The description can be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

Enabled

Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设备注册策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The list of whitelisted users for the device registration policy. You can add up to 1,000 usernames
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户列表。最多可输入1000个用户名。必传
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The priority of the device registration policy. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The value 0 indicates the highest priority, and 99 indicates the lowest priority
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略优先级。数字0表示优先级最高，数字99表示优先级最低
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The registration limit type for corporate devices. Valid values:

Unlimited: No limit.

LimitAll: Limits the total number of devices.

LimitDiff: Limits devices by terminal type
parameters.help_zh:
公司设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制
parameters.name: company_limit_type

fields.help_en: The total number of corporate devices that can be registered. The value can be from 0 to 100. The default value is 0. This parameter is valid only when CompanyLimitType is set to LimitAll
fields.help_zh: 公司设备注册限制总数。取值范围为0～100，默认为0。当公司设备注册限制类型为LimitAll时，该字段的值有效
fields.name: all

fields.help_en: The number of corporate mobile devices that can be registered. The value can be from 0 to 100. The default value is 0. This parameter is valid only when CompanyLimitType is set to LimitDiff
fields.help_zh: 公司设备注册限制移动端登录数量。取值范围为0～100，默认为0。当公司设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效
fields.name: mobile

fields.help_en: The number of corporate PCs that can be registered. The value can be from 0 to 100. The default value is 0. This parameter is valid only when CompanyLimitType is set to LimitDiff
fields.help_zh: 公司设备注册限制PC端登录数量。取值范围为0～100，默认为0。当公司设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效
fields.name: pc

parameters.help_en: The registration limit for corporate devices
parameters.help_zh: 公司设备注册限制数量
parameters.name: company_limit_count

parameters.help_en:
The registration limit type for personal devices. Valid values:

Unlimited: No limit.

LimitAll: Limits the total number of devices.

LimitDiff: Limits devices by terminal type
parameters.help_zh:
个人设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制
parameters.name: personal_limit_type

fields.help_en: The total number of personal devices that can be registered. The value can be from 0 to 100. The default value is 0. This parameter is valid only when PersonalLimitType is set to LimitAll
fields.help_zh: 个人设备注册限制总数。取值范围为0～100，默认为0。当个人设备注册限制类型为LimitAll时，该字段的值有效
fields.name: all

fields.help_en: The number of personal mobile devices that can be registered. The value can be from 0 to 100. The default value is 0. This parameter is valid only when PersonalLimitType is set to LimitDiff
fields.help_zh: 个人设备注册限制移动端登录数量。取值范围为0～100，默认为0。当个人设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效
fields.name: mobile

fields.help_en: The number of personal PCs that can be registered. The value can be from 0 to 100. The default value is 0. This parameter is valid only when PersonalLimitType is set to LimitDiff
fields.help_zh: 个人设备注册限制PC端登录数量。取值范围为0～100，默认为0。当个人设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效
fields.name: pc

parameters.help_en: The registration limit for personal devices
parameters.help_zh: 个人设备注册限制数量
parameters.name: personal_limit_count

parameters.help_en:
The matching target type of the policy. Valid values:

UserGroupAll: Associates with all users.

UserGroupNormal: Associates with specific user groups
parameters.help_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The IDs of user groups. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal. A policy can be associated with up to 100 user groups
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略的用户组ID集合，当策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时，必填。单个策略的用户组最大支持100个
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device registration policy. You can obtain the ID by calling one of the following operations:

[ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~)

[GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~)

[CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~)

[UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~)
parameters.help_zh:
设备注册策略ID。取值来源：
[ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~)：批量查询设备注册策略。
[GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~)：查询设备注册策略详情。
[CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~)：创建设备注册策略。
[UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~)：更新设备注册策略
parameters.name: policy_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the device registration policy was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 设备注册策略创建时间

Description.description_en: The description of the device registration policy
Description.example: 这是一条设备注册策略

LimitDetail.description_en: The list of limit details for the device registration policy
LimitDetail.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情列表

items.description_en: The limit details for the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情

DeviceBelong.description_en:
The owner of the device. Valid values:

Company: Corporate device.

Personal: Personal device
DeviceBelong.description_zh:
设备归属。取值：
Company：公司设备。
Personal：个人设备

All.description_en: The total number of devices that can be registered. This parameter is valid only when LimitType is set to LimitAll
All.description_zh: 设备注册限制总数。当设备注册限制类型为LimitAll时，该字段的值有效

Mobile.description_en: The number of mobile devices that can be registered. This parameter is valid only when LimitType is set to LimitDiff
Mobile.description_zh: 设备注册限制移动端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

PC.description_en: The number of PCs that can be registered. This parameter is valid only when LimitType is set to LimitDiff
PC.description_zh: 设备注册限制PC端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

LimitType.description_en:
The registration limit type. Valid values:

Unlimited: No limit.

LimitAll: Limits the total number of devices.

LimitDiff: Limits devices by terminal type
LimitType.description_zh:
设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching target type of the policy. Valid values:

UserGroupAll: Associates with all users.

UserGroupNormal: Associates with specific user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组

Name.description_en: The name of the device registration policy

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the device registration policy

Priority.description_en: The priority of the device registration policy. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The value 0 indicates the highest priority, and 99 indicates the lowest priority
Priority.description_zh: 设备注册策略优先级。数字0表示优先级最高，数字99表示优先级最低

Status.description_en:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

Enabled

Disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备注册策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

UserGroupIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs for the device registration policy. This field has a value when the policy target type is UserGroupNormal
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 设备注册策略，用户组ID集合。当策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The user group ID for the device registration policy when the policy match target type is UserGroupNormal
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略，策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时的用户组ID

Whitelist.description_en: The list of whitelisted users for the device registration policy
Whitelist.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户列表

items.description_en: A whitelisted user for the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户
